page_data.en:
G. 90M-1
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No. ............
S. 1, Special Branch 9443
26/9/39
REPORT
Date September 19, 1939.
Subject Advertisement applying for employment.
Made by. D.P.S. Roberts Forwarded by. R W Mac Culie D S I.

Concerning the attached advertisement published
in the North China Daily News on September 8, 1939,
same was inserted to the order of Louis HART; a
Netherlander residing at 1434 Avenue Road.
Enquiries reveal that HART inherited a
considerable amount of money some few years ago and
commenced travelling about Europe.
Early this year HART decided to travel further
abroad and visited America, India and Australia
eventually arriving in Shanghai on May 10, 1939, with
practically no money at all.
Recently he has been trying to get to Chungking
with the object of securing a position with the
Government, or, failing that of joining the Chinese
Forces, but the Netherlands' Consul managed to
persuade him to remain in Shanghai and try and obtain
some sort of employment.
There is no file concerning this man at Police
Headquarters.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE SPECIAL BRANCH）
FILE
Read
20/9.

J. J. Roberts.
D. P. S.
D.C.(Special Branch).
page_data.zh:
G. 90M-1
上海公共租界工部局警务处。
档案号 ............
S. 1, 特别处 9443
1939年9月26日
报告
日期：1939年9月19日。
事由：关于求职广告。
呈报人：D.P.S. Roberts 转呈人：R W Mac Culie 副巡官。

关于附上的于1939年9月8日刊登在《字林西报》上的广告，该广告系受居住在爱文义路1434号的荷兰人 Louis HART 委托刊登。
经查询得知，HART 于数年前继承了一大笔钱财，并开始在欧洲各地游历。
今年初，HART 决定进一步出国旅行，访问了美国、印度和澳大利亚，最终于1939年5月10日抵达上海，当时几乎身无分文。
最近，他一直试图前往重庆，目的是在政府中谋得一个职位，若不成则加入中国军队，但荷兰领事成功说服他留在上海，尝试寻找某种工作。
警务处总部没有关于此人的档案。

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处特别处）
档案
已阅
9月20日。

J. J. Roberts.
D. P. S.
副巡官（特别处）。
